description: Analyse a variate (A/B) campaign — per-variant reports, statistical significance, engagement velocity, audience quality and geo split. Only meaningful for multivariate campaigns. All metrics come from synced BigQuery tables rather than a live Mailchimp read, so they are only as current as the project's last sync run, whose cadence is per-project: manual, daily or weekly.

campaignId.description: The opaque string identifier for the campaign as assigned by Mailchimp. List campaigns to obtain this ID. If the ID is invalid or does not exist in the project, the endpoint will return a 404 error.

projectId.description: Required. The opaque alphanumeric project identifier of 8 or more characters to scope this request to. Call GET /_api/public/v1/enterprise/projects to list the project IDs available to your API key. Omitting it returns 400 VALIDATION_ERROR.

name: sm_get_variate

outputSchema.description: Output for the sm_get_variate tool. Failure payloads arrive in the same envelope as { error, code }.

items.description: Measures the quality of audience engaging with the campaign.

avgEngagementScore.description: Mean engagement score in the variant, or null.

avgMemberRating.description: Mean member rating in the variant, or null.

repeatClickers.description: Members who clicked more than once.

repeatOpeners.description: Members who opened more than once.

code.description: A machine-readable identifier for the error type. For the full code taxonomy, see the sm_get_schema tool or the Enterprise API OpenAPI ErrorResponse component.

items.description: Velocity of opens and clicks post-send.

clicks.description: Click events for the variant in the window.

opens.description: Open events for the variant in the window.

variantLabel.description: Variant label, for example A or B.

error.description: A human-readable error message detailing what went wrong.

funnelData.description: Per-variant funnel rows from recipients through unique clickers.

items.description: Funnel metrics for a campaign or variant.

projectId.description: An opaque alphanumeric project identifier of 8 or more characters identifying a Space Monkey Project. Treat this value as entirely opaque; do not parse, sequentialize, or auto-generate it.

items.description: Analysis of time until the first open occurs.
Performance reports split by campaign variant.

clicksTotal.description: Total click events for the variant.

opensTotal.description: Total open events for the variant.

variantLabel.description: A, B, C, or Campaign for non-variate

title: Analyze variate campaign
